hooks.command: branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ] && [ "$branch" != "main" ] && [ "$branch" != "HEAD" ]; then state=$(gh pr view "$branch" --json state -q .state 2>/dev/null); if [ "$state" = "MERGED" ]; then if git checkout main >/dev/null 2>&1 && git pull >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"ブランチ '$branch' のPRがマージ済みだったため main に切り替えて最新化しました\"}"; fi; fi; fi
